# Third-party libraries

These files are bundled unmodified so the app works offline with no CDN requests.

| File | Library | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf-lib.esm.min.js` | [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) | MIT |
| `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs` | [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) 4.10.38 | Apache-2.0 |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) 3.10.2 | MIT (dual MIT / GPLv3) |
